limits: Review is of immutable snapshots; production content was not edited. All 680 five-clue categories were read semantically in both languages with responses, variants and explanations.
Selective external checking is documented per finding and category; this is not external verification of all 3400 facts.
Internal cross-clue leaks, finite-pool elimination and title coherence are assessed from the five-clue category as read, independent of existing approvals or test status.

B-080 original DOOM location is a factual candidate awaiting primary manual confirmation; the original moons-versus-2016-Mars distinction should be checked before repair.

B-033 cover lettering is supported internally by the London Calling lettering prompt and familiar cover knowledge; official album pages were read, but their cover images did not load through the research tool.

Specialist source questions retained as notes rather than confirmed defects include Bell Labs Daisy Bell machine model, Ziggy narrative, Sweet Child origin attribution, and several art-history superlatives. The isolated easiest-tier criticism B-001, historically valid Kasparov wording B-067 and broad Cuba regional priming B-047 were withdrawn during triage.
